fields.Name: IT187 - Comms V2 Send Pipeline and Templated Delivery
fields.Description: Exercises V2SendService.Send (DryRun, tracking tokens, HMAC signatures, chunked comms.dispatch, a suppressed recipient) and TemplatedCommunicationService.RenderAndSend against the live database. In-process by design: V2 Send has no wire of its own, and these checks need a stand-in provider or an injected enqueue hook. CV2S4 sends to a recipient with an active Hard Bounce suppression and asserts the outcome is Blocked, no Communication Log is written and the provider is never called; the same block is asserted over GraphQL by IT187.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: V2SendService.Send persists runs/logs with tracking tokens, chunks above AsyncThreshold, blocks a suppressed recipient without calling the provider, and TemplatedCommunicationService renders and sends DryRun.
